as_told.title: New Jersey drone flap before Disclosure Day filming
as_told.place_text: New Jersey; Morris County; Picatinny Arsenal

plain: In November 2024 a wave of drone and UFO sightings swept New Jersey, and one theory links it to the filming of Disclosure Day, a Steven Spielberg film about aliens. Michels says the theory belongs to his friend Chris Ramsay, who runs a show called Area 52, and that the film was shot in New Jersey in late 2024. In a later episode Michels tells it his own way: production began in February 2025, a few months after the sightings, and he names Morris County and the Picatinny Arsenal military site, without crediting Ramsay.
